implementation.automatic_scope: Git registrations whose worktree paths are absent, Git marks prunable, and no live claim matches any prunable registration in that repository
implementation.preservation_rule: Existing worktree directories are report-only and are never removed; a live claim matching any prunable registration blocks all pruning for that repository
implementation.branch_preservation: git worktree prune removes registration metadata only and leaves the task branch intact

authentic_adjacent_finding.summary: Sanctioned worktree creation exposed an independent transient canonical-lock TOCTOU failure while traversing a different live worktree's Git admin directory.
authentic_adjacent_finding.disposition: Sent to the exact canonical-lock claim owner without overlapping its paths.
